keys.description: Your server sends a key in the {{header}} header to create payments. A key is shown only once, when you create it.
keys.createDescription: Give the key a name so you can recognise it later.
keys.createdDescription: This is the only time the full key is shown. Store it somewhere safe.
keys.name: Name
keys.nameHint: For example the name of your store or server.
keys.revokeDescription: "{{name}}" will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
keys.emptyDescription: Create a key to accept payments from your website.
keys.loadError: Could not load your API keys.

payments.description: Create a payment link for an order and send it to your customer. Links expire after 30 minutes.
payments.createDescription: Each order reference can be used for one payment only.
payments.createdDescription: Send this link to your customer. They pay it from their wallet.
payments.orderHint: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
payments.cancelDescription: The link for order {{order}} ({{amount}}) will stop working.
payments.refundDescription: {{amount}} for order {{order}} will be sent back to the customer from your wallet.
payments.emptyDescription: Payments you create here or through the API appear in this list.
payments.descriptionPlaceholder: What the customer is paying for
payments.returnUrlHint: Where the customer is sent after paying, for example your order confirmation page.

checkout.description: Check the details before you pay from your wallet.
checkout.confirmDescription: {{amount}} will be taken from your wallet and sent to {{merchant}}.
checkout.notFound: This payment link is not valid.

webhook.title: Payment callback
webhook.description: We call this address on your server whenever one of your payments is paid, cancelled, expired or refunded.
webhook.urlHint: Must be a public https address.
webhook.secretHint: Use it to check that a callback really came from us. Removing the callback and adding it again creates a new secret.
webhook.loadError: Could not load your callback settings.
